mapper.select: SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, level, exp, created_at, role, enabled, solved_count, current_streak, max_streak, last_login_at FROM user ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, level, exp, created_at, role, enabled, solved_count, current_streak, max_streak, last_login_at FROM user WHERE user_id = #{id}
SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, level, exp, created_at, role, enabled, solved_count, current_streak, max_streak, last_login_at FROM user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, level, exp, created_at, role, enabled, solved_count, current_streak, max_streak, last_login_at FROM user WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (email, password, nickname, level, exp, role, enabled, solved_count, current_streak, max_streak) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, 1, 0, 'USER', 1, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET email = #{email}, password = #{password}, nickname = #{nickname}, level = #{level}, exp = #{exp}, role = #{role}, enabled = #{enabled}, solved_count = #{solvedCount}, current_streak = #{currentStreak}, max_streak = #{maxStreak}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt} WHERE user_id = #{id}
